description.zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数
description.en: The maximum number of records to return in this request.

description.zh: 分页游标，如果有下一页，则该字段有返回值。说明 该参数只要返回数据，则说明还有下一页。您可以将返回的NextToken作为请求参数再次获得下一页的数据，直到返回为Null，表示获取到了所有的数据。
description.en: The pagination token. If more entries are to be returned on the next page, a pagination token is returned. Note: If this parameter returns data, it indicates there is a next page. You can use the returned NextToken as a request parameter to obtain the next page of data until it returns Null, indicating all data has been retrieved.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bdrc list-resource-categories --max-results 10 --next-token cae0000000000699 --resource-category-id rc-12300007890 --region cn-hangzhou
